description: This file defines the AwsCredentials class within the AWS SDK PHP CRT library. It manages AWS credential data including access key ID, secret access key, session token, and expiration time, providing constructor logic for initialization and cleanup procedures.

classes.name: AwsCredentials
classes.description: Represents a set of AWS credentials, including access key ID, secret access key, session token, and expiration time, extending NativeResource management.

methods.name: defaults
methods.description: Returns default credential options as an array.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access credential properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes AwsCredentials object with provided options, validates required fields, and sets up native resource.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Releases native resources and cleans up upon object destruction.
